name: Labourer
description: Somebody has to dig the latrines. And the moat.
long_description: No glamour, no glory, no day off. Labourers swing the pick, haul the timber and raise the walls everyone else sleeps behind. Weak in a fight and they know it - but every safehouse standing is standing because of one. Mastery leads to Builder, Miner, or Trader.
